result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, with one clear content defect: the promotional badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '−100%', which is an implausible discount value. The clipped carousel item and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scrolling behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second restaurant card under 'Popular right now' (the pizza card) shows '−100%'. This is an implausible discount and is most likely a wrong or miscalculated value, or a formatting bug. It could mislead users into expecting a free order.
issues.suggestion: Check the data source and the discount calculation and formatting logic for this badge. Display the real discount (e.g. '−10%' or '−20%'), and add validation so out-of-range values such as 100% or more are not rendered.
